subject: CLASS clause
notes: docs/CONFORMANCE.md §5 row A.4.14 (VALIDATE — Not claimed) + §4 item 3, which already named CLASS a validation clause. Licence: Annex A.4.1, "An implementation shall accept the syntax and provide the functionality for an optional element only when support for that language element is claimed by the implementor", and its second sentence carrying the licence to the module's unlisted rules — which is the sentence CLASS needs, because Annex A.4 never LISTS this clause. OWNER DECISION, kb/Work PB375, 2026-09-02: the clause is DECLINED WITH VALIDATE, on §13.16.2's own ground — the printed Format-1 validation-clauses group opens with `[ class-clause ]` and maps it to "13.18.11, CLASS clause" (RENDERED, PDF p394 / folio 364) — and §13.18.11.1 leaves it no content outside the module. Refused BY NAME (COBOL1708) where it drew a bare "COBOL0307: unexpected 'CLASS'" before. Editions are the DATA-DESCRIPTION clause's band, not the word's: CLASS itself is reserved at all four editions (§12.3.7 SPECIAL-NAMES CLASS clause), so at --std 85 this entry is an ordinary syntax error rather than this decline.
